name: Scavengers
body:
Your travelers are adept at scavenging additional repair supplies in the wild.

Benefit: Once per week, you can make a DC 15 Security check to gain 1 cargo unit of repair materials. You gain an additional 1 cargo unit of repair materials for every 5 points by which you exceed this DC 15 check.
